BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'task' AND column_name = 'task_kind'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN task_kind varchar(64)';
    END IF;
END $$;

UPDATE task
SET task_kind = CASE "type"
    WHEN 1 THEN 'frontend_preview'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'fullstack_page'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'cli_programming'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'api_endpoint'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'debug_fix'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'refactor_quality'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'git_cli'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'sql_query'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'quiz_theory'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'project_milestone'
    ELSE 'frontend_preview'
END;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN task_kind SET DEFAULT 'frontend_preview';

UPDATE task
SET task_kind = COALESCE(task_kind, 'frontend_preview');

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN task_kind SET NOT NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'execution_mode'
          AND data_type = 'smallint'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN execution_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN execution_mode TYPE varchar(32)
            USING CASE execution_mode
                WHEN 1 THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'HTTP_API'
                WHEN 4 THEN 'NO_RUN'
                ELSE 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'evaluation_mode'
          AND data_type = 'smallint'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode TYPE varchar(32)
            USING CASE evaluation_mode
                WHEN 1 THEN 'AUTO'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'MANUAL'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'HYBRID'
                ELSE 'AUTO'
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'ui_mode'
          AND data_type = 'smallint'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN ui_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN ui_mode TYPE varchar(32)
            USING CASE ui_mode
                WHEN 1 THEN 'PREVIEW'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'TERMINAL'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'REPORT'
                WHEN 4 THEN 'QUIZ'
                ELSE 'PREVIEW'
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN execution_mode SET DEFAULT 'BROWSER_PREVIEW',
    ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode SET DEFAULT 'AUTO',
    ALTER COLUMN ui_mode SET DEFAULT 'PREVIEW';

ALTER TABLE task
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "type";

COMMIT;
